scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/wrangler.mjs dev --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8790
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy --dry-run --outdir test-results/bundle
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/check-deploy.mjs && node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:worker && npm run test:browser
